title: [29.X]-Order Planning Calculate Plan Stops on Blocked Item and Does Not Process Remaining Valid Demand.
summary: Order Planning feature now correctly processes remaining valid demand items when a blocked item is encountered instead of stopping the entire calculation.
key_points: Prevents order planning calculation from halting on blocked items
Enables continued processing of remaining valid demand
Adds field and logic updates to Order Planning Management and Requisition Line
Includes comprehensive test coverage for the scenario
